inPart.edit.noWay: {at} has no way to change it (one of edit, append, prepend)
inPart.edit.strayKey: {at} cannot take {stray} (write the text whole, or change a part of it with edit, append or prepend)
inPart.one.manyFound: {at}.old matches {n} places in the {what} (add the text around it to narrow it to one, or all: true for every one)
inPart.one.newNeeded: {at}.new needs the text to put in its place (empty text to delete)
inPart.one.notFound: {at}.old is not in the {what} (it is looked for exactly as written; card_read's find in value can search for it)
inPart.read.contextRange: context is a number from 0 to {most}
inPart.read.findAndLines: find and lines cannot be used together
inPart.read.findText: find is the text to look for
inPart.read.fromNeeded: lines.from is required (line numbers start at 1)
inPart.read.fromPast: lines.from is past the body's number of lines ({count})
inPart.read.fromPastLines: lines.from is past the body's lines (lines {first} to {last})
inPart.read.linesNumber: lines.{key} is a line number from 1
inPart.read.linesShape: lines is {from, to} (line numbers start at 1)
inPart.read.noBody: {path} has no body (lines reads a body: the body of a freedoc, note, goal or task, a formatdoc's text rows, and a stackdoc's versions. find also searches everything inside a formatdoc, stackdoc or flow and its items)
